name: Client Onboarding & Intake
summary: Turn a signed deal into a smooth start with forms, documents, welcome sequences, and kickoff.
description: The first two weeks of a relationship set the tone for everything after. They are also where most teams improvise, chasing paperwork by email and retyping intake details into three different systems. These automations collect what you need up front, sync it to the right places, send a welcome sequence that answers questions before they are asked, and schedule the kickoff, so every new client gets the same organized experience.
